card.name: Endings of Latin and foreign words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a Latin or other foreign word split into parts, often inside a quotation or citation. Also the word "printed" in "Article printed from" web footers.

modes.label: Latin word endings
modes.description: Last piece of a Latin or Greek word in a quote or inscription.

modes.label: Web footer
modes.description: The word printed in the "Article printed from" line at the end of a scraped post.

modes.label: Foreign title endings
modes.description: Ending of a non-English word in a bibliography entry.

card.plain: It lights up at the tail end of Latin or foreign words, and at the words "Article printed from" in web page footers.
